scenarios.title: Supply Chain & Warehouse
scenarios.description: Northwind Motion builds e-bikes and e-scooters in 4 European plants. Battery cells come from Asia, frames from Portugal. Summer 2026 was rough: a key battery supplier slipped and warehouses filled up with half-finished bikes.
scenarios.question: Help the COO answer: are we going to be able to ship the Christmas season, and where exactly is the bottleneck?

scenarios.title: Sales & Order-to-Cash
scenarios.description: Northwind Motion sells e-bikes and scooters to dealers and fleet customers across Europe. Revenue is seasonal (spring and summer peak) and a few large fleet deals make or break the year.
scenarios.question: Help the Head of Sales answer: will we hit the annual plan, which regions are lagging, and who owes us money?

scenarios.title: Sustainability & Carbon
scenarios.description: Northwind Motion committed to cutting CO2e emissions 50% by 2030 (vs. 2023). Every plant reports energy, emissions and waste monthly. Investors now ask for this data next to the financials.
scenarios.question: Help the Chief Sustainability Officer answer: are we on track for the 2030 target, and which plant or initiative needs attention?

endpoints.description: Titles, labels and the business question for the scenario.
4 headline numbers: value, unit, target, trend (Up/Down), state (Good/Critical/Error/Neutral) and a 6-month history.
One row per plant/region: name, value, target, share (%), state.
Business records for a table: id, title, subtitle, owner, date, amount, currency, quantity, progress (0-100), status, state.
Things that need attention: type (Error/Warning/Information/Success), title, description, date.
